scope.feature: Opt-in bounded timer trigger for same-page select-tab Page Actions.
scope.allowlist: timer is accepted only for select-tab; delayMs must be exactly 3000, 5000, or 10000; other actions, arbitrary delays, and unexpected fields are rejected.
scope.behavior: Public page and Preview schedule the tab action once at initialization; the Editor Canvas does not run it. An explicit URL tab state and successful load action win; user focus/pointer/tab use cancels the pending timer for that target; hidden-tab and popstate cancel timers; the timer does not write URL/history.
scope.save_publish: The browser lifecycle regression verifies Save leaves the published action unchanged, Preview reads the draft, and separate Publish enables the timer on the public route.
scope.no_side_effects: No arbitrary JavaScript, navigation, workflow execution, database write/migration, R2 mutation, dependency, or paid resource.
